purpose: Test one bounded navigation-plan repair after iteration14 revealed a compute-only plan for a fresh navigation request.
hypothesis: Rejecting deficient grounded navigation command plans before dispatch and allowing one full-context repair prevents the missing activation without creating writes for route queries or cancelled/incomplete requests.
scope: Five production files add a car-only contract and one coordinator-owned semantic repair. Covered complete nonempty whole commands must ground uniquely, activate a matching current-plan computed route, and include exactly one start with no cancel/waypoint mutation. No-call/incomplete/unknown/ambiguous/question/negated/compound requests retain current handling. Responder, recorder, model configuration, audio inputs and expected effects are unchanged.
controls: First reproduce the omission in deterministic tests using independent places; verify repair failure and correction-during-repair cause no obsolete dispatch.
Freeze full tested source and models before one cancel/repeat/repeat/cancel live suite using exact iteration14 WAVs.
Keep all rejected plans and logical repair attempts distinct from actual dispatched calls and parser-level JSON retries.
Retain all cases including missing final speech facts, refusal/clarification instead of action, or repeated missing activation. No retries/exclusions.
Review every whole received stream once after timed services exit.
unchanged_limits: Reused development audio is not held-out evidence.
Small serial fixed-order replay cannot prove a causal latency improvement or population accuracy.
Response-wording defect is deliberately unchanged and continues to be scored.
Physical audibility/human echo, FDB evaluation and organizer brief remain separate requirements.

prelaunch_validation.independent_review: No blocker for narrow contract; independent-code-review.json records exact scope and preserved check method.
